item.title: €5.3m for Housing Adaptation Grant across region
item.description: Over €5 million has been announced to improve homes for older and disabled people across the Northern Sound region. The funding was announced for Cavan and Monaghan under the Housing Adaptation Grant, and forms part of a wider national package which will see total projected funding of over €152 million allocated nationwide. item.title: €337m takeover for company with Cavan office
item.description: Zurich Insurance's Irish branch has today (Monday, 9th March) announced that it is buying the former Liberty Insurance from Italian company Generali for €337 million. In 2024, Generali bought the former Liberty Insurance, and rebranded the business as RedClick. The company has a workforce of over 400 employees, across offices in Cavan, Enniskillen, and Dublin. item.title: Delivery of new Scotstown playpark praised locally
item.description: A local councillor has praised the delivery of a new playpark at Lui na Grene housing estate in Scotstown. Work on a small play area in Lui na Greine housing estate in Scotstown is almost complete. Funding of €18,887 was provided for this project by the Department of Children, Disability and Equality in 2025. item.description: A local man has been reacting to increases in fuel prices. As the conflict in the Middle East moves into a second week, financial pain is being felt locally. item.title: Local farmer welcomes reopening of cross border trade
item.description: A local farmer has said that the bluetongue virus isn't currently spreading, rather detection is very intense across farms, particularly in the south-east. Newbliss farmer, David Hall, is the IFA's Animal Health chair. He believes that recent confirmed cases of the Bluetongue virus come from the original infection back in September. item.title: More female representation 'needed' in politics
item.description: Cavan-Monaghan TD Cathy Bennett is encouraging more women to get involved in local and national politics. In celebration of International Women' Day, Deputy Bennett said while some progress has been made, there is still not enough female representation in the political field. Before the 2024 local elections, Deputy Bennett was one of only two female councillors on Monaghan County Council. item.description: Cavan star Niamh Keenaghan has been honoured with The Croke Park Hotel/LGFA Player of the Month award for February 2026. Cavan were crowned Lidl National League Division 3 champions in 2025. Niamh and her teammates were in excellent form again this year, a second successive promotion could be on the cards. item.title: Monaghan-made film wins prestigious award
item.description: A short film shot in County Monaghan has won the Audience Award for Best Short Film at the 2026 Dublin International Film Festival. Molly & The Robot, directed by Monaghan filmmaker Táine King, received the award following its screening at the Lighthouse Cinema in Dublin during this year’s festival. The award is voted for directly by audiences and recognises the film that resonated most strongly with viewers. item.title: Murdered Enniskillen woman named
item.description: Detectives from the Police Service of Northern Ireland’s Major Investigation Team, who launched a murder inquiry following the death of a woman in Enniskillen on Saturday 7th March, have named the deceased as Ellie Flanagan. Ellie, aged 23, was found dead at an address in the Corban Avenue area of Enniskillen, by officers who were carrying out enquiries relating to a collision which took place on the Carn Road near Tempo at around 9.15pm on Saturday. item.title: Michael Duffy named SSE Airtricity/SWI player of the month
item.description: Michael Duffy of Derry City has been named SSE Airtricity/Soccer Writers Ireland Player of the Month for February. The 31-year-old topped the nationwide poll in a two-horse race to edge out Bohemians striker, Colm Whelan by a mere three votes. Bohs’ midfielder, Dawson Devoy took third place. Duffy, won the monthly gong last June. Indeed, he has continued his scintillating form at the start of the new season with some excellent performances and four goals for the Candy stripes.
